# Mikołaj Piech

> Founder & developer who designs and builds web apps, mobile apps, websites, and digital products.

Founder of Clevr Apps and developer from Poland who designs, builds, and ships web apps, mobile apps, websites, and consumer software from idea to launch. Co-founder of Jedziemy, creator of Trailo, Twoja Sieć, Subby, Doso, and Solvee, and co-creator of Safe Labs.

I design and build apps. I run Clevr Apps and co-founded Jedziemy.
